positioning: MongoDB-like document workloads through SonnetDB APIs; not MongoDB protocol compatibility

statusDefinitions.supported: Implemented, externally reachable, and covered by automated evidence.
statusDefinitions.partial: A documented SonnetDB-native subset is implemented; callers must account for listed differences.
statusDefinitions.planned: Accepted future work outside the completed Milestone 32 scope.
statusDefinitions.not_planned: Explicitly excluded; use the documented alternative.

features.summary: Typed filter, projection, sort and update builders use AOT-friendly JSON values.
Bounded page cursor with invalid, mismatch, expired and stale error codes.
$mul and $pop are available in Core, HTTP and the .NET SDK.
Atomic filter-and-update returns the before or after document and supports upsert.
$elemMatch, $size and $all use element-scoped and array-aware semantics.
Bounded $regex, JSON $type and recursively nested $not are implemented.
Object properties, implicit array traversal and explicit numeric array indices have distinct boundaries.
The M32 basic collation scope supports ordinal and ordinal-ignore-case string filtering and sorting with cursor fingerprint isolation.
Locale, strength and Unicode-normalization-aware collation is a possible post-M32 extension and has no compatibility promise or delivery date.
features.alternative: Normalize locale-sensitive sort keys into explicit fields before indexing.

features.summary: Path indexes fan out array values, deduplicate per-document entries and reject compound parallel arrays.
A subtree wildcard index is creatable through Core and HTTP and is visible to the planner.
EXPLAIN distinguishes path, wildcard and scan access; one WAL batch covers primary/path-index/feed state and a repair marker rebuilds derived indexes.
$project and $group accept field/literal/arithmetic/concat/ifNull/cond expressions; group adds push/addToSet and unwind adds array index output.
The SonnetDB-native bounded pipeline is not the complete MongoDB aggregation language.
features.alternative: Use supported stages, SonnetDB SQL, or application-side composition.

features.summary: $lookup, $facet and a dedicated $bucket stage are excluded from the M32 native subset because they add cross-collection or multiply-buffered execution boundaries.
features.alternative: Use SQL JOIN/CASE/grouping, multiple bounded aggregate calls, or application composition.

features.summary: One batch may mix insert, replace, update-one, update-many, delete-one, delete-many and upsert with per-item results.
Ordered errors commit zero mutations; unordered batches atomically commit their valid subset inside one collection.
A requestId binds an unambiguous length-prefixed payload fingerprint for 24 hours and persists replay results across restart; mismatched payloads fail with idempotency_conflict.
Empty requests and irrelevant per-operation fields are rejected; operation-count, canonical-payload and atomic-WAL budget failures return stable batch_too_large without mutations.
sndb document import streams JSON arrays, bounds strict UTF-8 NDJSON records, and converts common Extended JSON scalars with dry-run and machine reports.

Concatenated mongodump BSON supports common scalar, object, array, ObjectId, date, binary, regex and timestamp values; Decimal128 and uncommon deprecated/code types require canonical Extended JSON export.
features.alternative: Export canonical Extended JSON when the machine report emits unsupported_bson_type; corrupt or truncated input is reported separately as invalid_bson.

features.summary: Content-derived batch IDs, validated checkpoints, local/remote profiles, index suggestions, total error counts and bounded error samples make retry and resume explicit.
Web/Studio imports files through the browser or native bridge, safely maps common Extended JSON IDs, writes mixed Bulk batches and renders per-item errors.
The same sample code runs embedded or remote and demonstrates builders, cursor, findOneAndUpdate, mixed Bulk and replay.
MongoDB wire protocol, BSON commands, MongoDB URI and official driver connectivity are not implemented.
features.alternative: Use SndbDocumentClient, SonnetDB HTTP API or SQL.

features.summary: Replica set, sharding, cross-database distributed transactions and MongoDB read/write concern are outside the single-node product boundary.
features.alternative: Use deployment-level backup/recovery and explicit application workflows.

features.summary: MongoDB positional $, $[] and arrayFilters syntax are not part of the SonnetDB update contract.
features.alternative: Replace the bounded array/document or perform an explicit read-modify-write with expectedVersion.

features.summary: MongoDB hashed, 2d and 2dsphere index semantics are not mapped to Document path indexes.
features.alternative: Use explicit normalized fields, SonnetDB geo/SQL capabilities, or application-specific indexing.
